source: Zephyr PE QST baseline plus legacy tests/legacy/pe/qst automation
policy: Historical reuse plan, not coverage proof. Legacy PE/ST2 automation may be mined for unique behavior, but current regional implementation lives under tests/markets/pe/qst and must be runtime-validated independently before coverage promotion.

SAM-25140.title: Order confirmation screen
SAM-25140.notes: Current PE EPP code is discovery-only and does not place/confirm an EPP order. A real guarded EPP order flow is still required.

SAM-25138.title: Payment using credit card with reg user
SAM-25138.notes: Current PE EPP code is discovery-only and does not submit a registered-user credit-card order. Do not infer coverage from Base Store.
